_comment: What the build scripts put in the runtime folder. Windows (packaging/build_windows.py): the official embeddable CPython from python.org and pip. macOS (packaging/build_macos.py): python-build-standalone's relocatable CPython for Apple silicon, which includes pip and the shared libpython the app's launcher embeds. Add-ons such as the Kokoro voice engine are pip-installed at run time. All pinned by SHA-256. Python 3.13 because the Kokoro engine doesn't support 3.14 yet.
